text:
zara-ui: saw a user report: Typescript errors when using SDK in Next.js app without DOM lib. error points to our RequestInit usage in generated types.

ben-m: we should ship an ambient declaration in our package like "types/fetch-shim.d.ts" that safely declares RequestInfo/RequestInit only if not already present. fallback lives inside our declaration file with triple-slash types?

sam-eng: hmm triple-slash might still force include. better to provide namespaced types we export like `import type { Fetch } from '@redwood/inference/dist/fetch-types'`. boring but explicit.

docsy: docs: add a short FAQ entry: "TS errors about RequestInit" with copy-and-paste snippet to add to tsconfig if they want DOM lib, plus how to import our shim types for minimal solution.

devex-bot: ticket created #DX-487 for follow-up (assign: sam-eng).

zara-ui: thanks — also include a note about polyfills that bundlers sometimes inject. I'll add a small Next.js example in the docs.

sam-eng: will include the types file and docs in the PR. folks — let's try to keep the default dev experience minimal for edge users.
